title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-22
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a top‑ten ’69 show with a smoking Dark Star, Mountains of the Moon and an epic The Eleven sequence.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑remastered SBD version turns what was once a muddy tape into one of the most listenable 1969 recordings, offering pristine instrument separation, virtually no hiss and even correction of Phil’s bass distortion. Musically the concert is hailed as a top‑ten performance of the year, highlighted by Dark Star, Mountains of the Moon, The Other One and a blistering Doin’ That Rag → St. Stephen → The Eleven run. Overall the show is praised for its inspired playing, perfect set list and seamless flow.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both the performance (top‑ten ’69 show) and the remastered soundboard quality; average star rating ≈4.83.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remaster is described as crystal clear, crisp, with superb instrument separation and virtually no hiss; bass distortion removed. Minor notes mention occasional pitch‑correction sections and a few cut edits in the SBD vs OFF versions, but overall the mix is dynamic and clean.

standout_songs: Doin' That Rag > St. Stephen > The Eleven
show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers call the set list perfect and note seamless transitions, especially the powerful second‑set sequence; the show is regarded as a cohesive, high‑energy performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his superb guitar tone on Dark Star and throughout the show; described as ‘awesome’ and sounding better than any previous 1969 recording.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass distortion was removed in this version; his playing is noted as solid, especially launching Lovelight.
